subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• According to researcher Dr. Claire Murphy, "concentrating solar power systems...[are] capable of generating more energy per square meter annually as compared to similar capacity photovoltaic and wind power systems."
• Concentrating solar power plants typically employ solar power tower systems, linear Fresnel reflector systems, or parabolic trough systems to produce electricity from concentrated sunlight.
• The Noor Ouarzazate solar complex in Morocco uses a parabolic trough system.
• Dr. Murphy says that parabolic trough systems "circulate heat transfer fluid through a completely closed-loop system, therefore requiring minimal water consumption with significantly reduced environmental impact."
prompt: The student wants to use a quotation from Dr. Murphy to explain an advantage of the solar system at the Noor Ouarzazate complex. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Compared with solar power tower systems and linear Fresnel reflector systems, the parabolic trough system used at the Noor Ouarzazate complex is "capable of generating more energy per square meter annually," Dr. Murphy notes.
choices.B: Since they use a completely closed-loop system for heat transfer fluid, parabolic trough systems—such as the one at the Noor Ouarzazate complex—require "minimal water consumption," according to Dr. Murphy.
choices.C: According to Dr. Murphy, because it uses concentrated sunlight to produce electricity, the system used at the Noor Ouarzazate complex results in "significantly reduced environmental impact," making it environmentally friendly.
choices.D: The Noor Ouarzazate complex uses a parabolic trough system to produce electricity; in this type of solar system, heat transfer fluid is circulated "through a completely closed-loop system," Dr. Murphy explains.

explanation: Choice B is the best answer because it effectively explains a specific advantage of the Noor Ouarzazate system by connecting the parabolic trough's closed-loop feature to a concrete benefit. The sentence identifies that Noor Ouarzazate uses a parabolic trough system, explains the key feature (closed-loop heat transfer), and uses Dr. Murphy's quotation about 'minimal water consumption' to articulate the resulting advantage, directly accomplishing the goal of explaining why this system is beneficial.
